Metadata.description: Evangelical Faculty of Theology of Congo (FATEC), Kinshasa: biblical, theological and pastoral training for an effective, powerful and fruitful Christian ministry.

Common.mission: The primary mission of the Evangelical Faculty of Theology of Congo (FATEC) is to provide men and women serving God in His holy work with the foundational biblical, theological and pastoral knowledge needed for an effective, powerful and fruitful Christian ministry.

Home.heroEyebrow: Evangelical Faculty of Theology of Congo
Home.heroTitle: You already serve. Get trained to serve better.
Home.heroText: Bachelor’s (3 years), Master’s (2 years) and Doctorate (4 years), with day, evening or online classes: biblical, theological and pastoral knowledge in the service of God’s work.
Home.valuesText: Three pillars guide the training of every student.
Home.admissionsText: Are you serving in God’s work and want to deepen your biblical and theological training? Find out about admission requirements and the enrollment calendar.
Home.supportTitle: Support the training of God’s servants
Home.supportText: Your gifts fund scholarships, the library and the growth of the Faculty.
Home.campusText: FATEC welcomes you on Boulevard Triomphal, diagonally across from the Palais du Peuple. Day or evening classes, so you can study while serving in ministry.
Home.campusPhotoAlt: FATEC buildings on Boulevard Triomphal in Kinshasa

ProgramsPage.intro: FATEC offers programs from undergraduate to doctoral level, as well as an institute of biblical languages and a school for pastors’ wives.
ProgramsPage.modes: Study modes: on campus in Kinshasa, with day or evening classes, or online.
ProgramsPage.detailsSoon: Duration, schedule and tuition fees for each program: ask our admissions officer.
ProgramsPage.ctaText: See the application steps and the documents to prepare.
ProgramsPage.onlineNote: Online: the Bachelor’s degree is offered remotely; an online Master’s has been announced.
